info.name: Sentry Query Explore events in table format

params.name: organization_id_or_slug
params.description: The ID or slug of the organization.

params.name: field
params.description: The fields to select (may be specified multiple times).

params.name: query
params.description: An optional Sentry search query to filter events.

params.name: statsPeriod
params.description: Stats period (e.g., 24h, 14d).

params.name: start
params.description: Start date for the query range.

params.name: end
params.description: End date for the query range.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort by (prefix with - for descending).

params.name: project
params.description: Project IDs to filter by.

params.name: environment
params.description: Environment name to filter by.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor.

items.docs: Returns event data in table format, allowing you to slice and dice your events using various fields and aggregations.

info.name: Sentry Query Explore events in timeseries format

params.name: organization_id_or_slug
params.description: The ID or slug of the organization.

params.name: yAxis
params.description: The aggregate field to chart (e.g., count(), p50(transaction.duration)).

params.name: query
params.description: An optional search query to filter events.

params.name: statsPeriod
params.description: Stats period (e.g., 24h, 14d).

params.name: start
params.description: Start date for the query range.

params.name: end
params.description: End date for the query range.

params.name: interval
params.description: Resolution interval (e.g., 1h, 1d).

params.name: project
params.description: Project IDs to filter by.

params.name: environment
params.description: Environment name to filter by.

items.docs: Returns event data in timeseries format, suitable for charting and visualization over time.
